title: EOS — 3-cycle Claude remediation burn-down
intent:
Run a bounded multi-cycle remediation experiment through EOS using Claude Agent Master: fix the current repo-safe findings from #833, rerun the same 10-worker read-only sweep on the corrected state, take the new prioritized list, fix again, and repeat so we can observe finding turnover across multiple complete cycles.

Required work:
Run exactly 3 full remediation cycles. Each cycle is:
1. Start from the current prioritized findings list (Cycle 1 starts from #833).
2. Implement the highest-priority repo-safe/non-protected findings that are sufficiently specified and testable.
3. Add or update focused regression tests for every implemented fix.
4. Run relevant test/build/lint checks. If a fix fails verification, allow at most one correction attempt; then mark it UNRESOLVED and continue without looping.
5. After the implementation batch is green, launch exactly 10 parallel read-only Agent Master workers using the same #833 scopes:
   - inventory/transfer integrity
   - truck inventory/allocation/reservation
   - receiving readiness
   - work-order idempotency/replay/races
   - dispatcher/assignment/parts-readiness
   - Firestore Rules/authorization tail
   - privileged-callable/deployment-boundary review
   - sales/fulfillment
   - equipment/technician/field-mode
   - cross-system P0/P1 sweep
6. Use one consolidator only. Dedup against #802, #818, #819, EOS-STRESS-RUN-001, #831, #833, and all earlier cycles in this run.
7. Produce the next prioritized finding list and classify each item as FIXED_THIS_CYCLE, NEW, DUP_STILL_OPEN, ELEVATED, CLEAN, UNRESOLVED, OWNER_BLOCKED, or PROTECTED_DEFERRED.
8. Continue into the next cycle using that new list.

Cycle 1 should prioritize the repo-safe #833 items where evidence supports implementation, including:
- updateWorkOrderExecutionData replay/idempotency protection;
- warehouseService stock floor/sufficiency protection;
- createTransferOrder idempotency;
- dispatcher ScoreBreakdown scope crash;
- createWorkOrder idempotency only if not already fixed by the current branch/main state.
Do not autonomously implement Sales fulfilledQty semantics, privileged-callable deployment policy, technician equipment-access policy, deployments, Rules changes, or other genuine Owner/protected decisions; classify and carry them forward instead.

Cost/capacity:
- No implicit economic-cost cap.
- Modeled Claude cost is telemetry only.
- Stop only for a real governed capacity/concurrency/Owner-reserve limit or another fail-closed runtime condition.
- Record actualProviderCostUsd as authoritative billed cost or UNKNOWN.
- Record estimatedExecutionCostUsd separately.

Completion:
Complete only after exactly 3 bounded remediation cycles have finished (or a real governed capacity limit stops further work), with each cycle containing implementation → tests → 10-worker rerun → consolidation.
Publish a durable governed report containing:
- files changed and tests by cycle;
- findings fixed per cycle;
- new findings discovered per cycle;
- finding-count/severity turnover from #833 → Cycle 1 → Cycle 2 → Cycle 3;
- items that survived all cycles and why;
- genuine Owner/protected decisions only;
- 10-worker telemetry for each rerun;
- total Claude Agent Master calls/tokens/duration where exposed;
- whether quality, duplicate rate, or coordination degraded across repeated cycles;
- final prioritized residual list;
- whether another cycle would have meaningful marginal value.

Artifactize all source changes as a governed scoped patch/result under the existing EOS write-back model. Do not apply the patch to main automatically. Explicitly confirm main/product/production were not mutated by this experiment.
scope: Execution: EOS → Claude Agent Master in one isolated disposable worktree → bounded implementation + verification cycles → existing Verifier → governed patch/report artifacts only.
Do not merge, deploy, alter production, grant permissions, modify Firestore Rules, activate providers, change credentials, or cross any protected Owner boundary.
Use #833 as the starting finding baseline. Preserve all work in the isolated worktree across cycles so later workers inspect the corrected state from prior cycles.
